references.text: The Sea of Kinneret (Sea of Galilee) is mentioned as a boundary marker, the same place as the city of Kinneret in Joshua 19:35
Kinneret is mentioned as part of the areas given to the tribes, including the Sea of Kinneret as a border
The region of Kinneret is mentioned in connection with Ben-Hadad's conquest of Israelite cities
Gennesaret (the Greek name for Kinneret) is mentioned as the place where Jesus and his disciples came ashore
The Sea of Gennesaret is the same as the Sea of Kinneret, where Jesus taught the crowds
